info.name: Moriah Skill Hub API (role-aware)
info.description:
Generated by scripts/gen-postman.py from docs/openapi.json.

## Quick start
1. `Auth / Login — student1` (and any other role you need). Each stores a ROLE-SPECIFIC token: {{studentAccessToken}}, {{pmAccessToken}}, {{devAccessToken}}, {{salesAccessToken}}, {{baAccessToken}}, {{clientAccessToken}}.
2. Admin / HR: run the 3 steps in `Auth / Login — admin (2FA)` — step 3's pre-request script auto-computes the TOTP from the secret step 2 stored. -> {{adminAccessToken}}, {{hrAccessToken}}.
3. Every other request already pins the correct role token (see each request's description for which roles are allowed and which var it uses).
4. Seeded user UUIDs are pre-filled variables: {{student1Uuid}} ... {{adminUuid}}. Carry-over IDs ({{batchId}}, {{sprintId}}, {{submissionId}}, ...) are blank — set them from earlier responses (see docs/testing-flow.md).
5. Webhooks self-sign with {{webhookSecret}} (match your .env).
6. OAuth2 login is a browser flow, not a request — see its folder.
